newsitem.title: USA: GM plans news conference with Hughes, Raytheon.
newsitem.headline: GM plans news conference with Hughes, Raytheon.

text.p: General Motors Corp. said Thursday it scheduled a news conference with Hughes Electronics Corp. and Raytheon Co. at about 4 p.m. EST (/2100 GMT) in New York City.

The news conference will feature GM Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Jack Smith, Hughes Electronics Chairman and Chief Executive Officer C. Michael Armstrong and Raytheon Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Dennis Picard.
